root_cause.text: The vulnerability exists because the `batadv_iv_ogm_can_aggregate` function does not validate whether the destination socket buffer has sufficient tailroom before permitting packet aggregation, allowing `skb_put` overflows when runtime configuration changes result in insufficient buffer space.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (skb_tailroom(forw_packet->skb) < packet_len) return false;` to `batadv_iv_ogm_can_aggregate`, fixing the issue described in the CVE where appending to an existing forwarded packet allocated with only `packet_len` bytes "can hit skb_put overflow conditions."
